MRCN_API_BASE_URL.description: Official CN mini-program API base URL

MRCN_REQUEST_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Default POST JSON template. Use {uid} placeholder.

MRCN_HEADERS_JSON.description: Request headers JSON. Keep temporary credentials local.

MRCN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Temporary access_token from the mini-program request header
MRCN_ACCESS_TOKEN.hint: 敏感凭据：仅在受控的 AstrBot WebUI 中填写，不要截图、分享或提交 data/config 下的配置文件。Token 过期后需要更新。

MRCN_CA_CERT.description: Optional CA PEM path, for example the mitmproxy CA certificate

MRCN_VERIFY_SSL.description: Keep TLS verification enabled; disable only for local diagnosis

MRCN_PROXY.description: Optional HTTP proxy, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080

MRCN_TRUST_ENV.description: Whether httpx should inherit HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY from the process environment

MRCN_MATCH_DETAIL_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Cache duration for immutable match-detail payloads

MRCN_MAX_INFLIGHT_REQUESTS.description: Maximum concurrent CN and Meta requests

MRCN_RENDER_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent HTML to PNG renders

MRCN_RENDER_RETRY_COUNT.description: Number of short retries after a render failure

MRCN_RENDER_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum seconds a render waits for an available render slot

MRCN_INTERACTION_SESSION_SECONDS.description: Lifetime of recent-match and time-window numeric selection sessions

MRCN_SIGNATURE_HERO_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum hero IDs in one career request for cross-season specialty analysis

MRCN_SIGNATURE_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent CN/Meta requests during specialty analysis

MRCN_SIGNATURE_SEASON_POLICY.description: Interpret CN season hero snapshots as independent or cumulative

MRCN_SIGNATURE_RESULT_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Fresh cache duration for final player career-analysis profiles (career and season scopes are isolated)

MRCN_SIGNATURE_HISTORY_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Cache duration for historical normalized HeroCareer season data

MRCN_SIGNATURE_CURRENT_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Cache duration for current normalized HeroCareer season data

MRCN_RATING_VERSION.description: Player rating mode: v1 keeps the legacy score, shadow computes V2 without changing output, v2 switches user-facing rating fields

MRCN_RATING_SPECIALIZATION_MIN_CONFIDENC.description: Minimum V2 confidence for specialization evidence; specialization also passes through the experience gate

MRCN_RATING_SPECIALIZATION_MIN_EXPERIENC.description: Minimum V2 experience for specialization evidence; specialization also passes through the confidence gate

MRCN_META_ENABLED.description: Enable third-party global hero Meta queries

MRCN_RIVALSMETA_BASE_URL.description: RivalsMeta base URL for global hero statistics

MRCN_META_CACHE_SECONDS.description: Fresh cache duration for global hero Meta data

MRCN_META_STALE_SECONDS.description: Maximum stale fallback duration for global hero Meta data

MRCN_ASSET_CACHE_DIR.description: Optional runtime asset cache directory; empty uses AstrBot plugin_data

MRCN_ASSET_REFRESH_DAYS.description: Revalidation interval for cached remote images

MRCN_ASSET_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum concurrent asset downloads during warmup

MRCN_ASSET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Timeout for one remote asset download in seconds

MRCN_DEFAULT_SEASON.description: Default season number used when a command does not specify one

MRCN_ROLE_PATH.description: Resolve and validate a public role ID
